summary_1line: Brahman explains the qualities of Passion and Goodness, contrasting them with Darkness and showing how each shapes conduct and spiritual destiny.

image_candidates.scene_text: A serene sage sits in meditation radiating calm light while shadowy figures around him chase wealth, quarrel, and indulge in worldly pleasures.
A symbolic triad of figures—one shrouded in darkness, one ablaze with restless motion, and one luminous and tranquil—represent the three qualities of nature.
